paragraphs_en: The production route reads the official current-year Suomen Hippos calendar for the 19 Racecourse Master main tracks. Seasonal non-master tracks and Paikallisravit local/temporary meetings remain explicitly out of scope; meeting clocks are not published as first-race times.
